name: fixes-week
what: The days before Fri Mar 15 run first, as a person stepping through the days does: a day judged here is a day a fill may take, and one the fill row draws as context

name: fixes-sheet
what: Sign-ins, Fri Mar 15: the file came with no rows and the day paused. The decision sheet offers what the sign-in file's ontology allows: carry a good day forward (or back), and replace the file; never a like day (an estimate), never the part alone

name: fixes-pick-fill
what: The fill picked: Thu 14's rows carried forward into Fri 15, stippled; Thu 14 solid, the week's other days faded beside it as examples; staged and checked before anything goes out
